title: Meet the Keyboard
description: Learn the black key and white key pattern and how it repeats.
steps: Find the group of two black keys.
Find the group of three black keys.
Locate a C using the two black keys pattern.

title: Finger Numbers
description: Learn finger numbers 1 to 5 and how to place your hand.
steps: Place your right hand on five white keys.
Say the numbers as you press each finger.

title: Middle C
description: Find Middle C and use it as your home base note.
steps: Find a group of two black keys near the center.
Middle C is the white key just left of those two black keys.
Play Middle C with finger 1 or 2 depending on your hand.

title: First Melody
description: Play a simple melody using finger numbers and steady rhythm.
steps: Go slow and keep the beat steady.

title: Rhythm Basics
description: Learn counts and clapping to build timing.
steps: Clap a steady beat and count 1 2 3 4.
Clap quarter notes then half notes.
Tap the rhythm before playing it on keys.

title: Simple Song Challenge
description: Try a short song and practice small sections.
steps: Fix mistakes slowly then speed up.
Play the full song when sections feel clean.
